shape.description: A 1-D integer Tensor or Python array. The shape of the output tensor.

mean.description: A Tensor or Python value of type `dtype`, broadcastable with `stddev`. The mean of the normal distribution.

stddev.description: A Tensor or Python value of type `dtype`, broadcastable with `mean`. The standard deviation of the normal distribution. dtype: The float type of the output: `float16`, `bfloat16`, `float32`, `float64`. Defaults to `float32`.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed for the distribution. See `tf.random.set_seed` for behavior.

output.description: A tensor of the specified shape filled with random normal values.
